source.extractionMethod: Clean embedded text layer, extracted directly with pdftotext -layout, cross-checked against page images not needed given clean text.

seasonWindows.note: From 2024 onward, only ONE rate applies year-round for all routes EXCEPT the Wilson/Mara/Wilson route, which still shows separate columns below (they are in fact identical figures across all 4 date windows in the source table, but the table structure itself is season-columned so recorded as-is rather than collapsed).

laikipiaToMasaiMaraAirstrips.unit: per person, either direction, all windows identical

nairobiToMasaiMaraAirstripsReturn.note: Return fare is $315 for Jan-Jun and Jul-Oct windows, $326 for Nov 1-Dec 15 and Dec 16-31 windows per source table columns.

discounts.multiFlight: 10% discount if 3+ flights booked with Governors Aviation in the same itinerary - NOT applicable to return-fare options.

scheduleFootnotes.a: Governors' Aviation reserves the right to route Nanyuki/Ol Pejeta (Komok) interchangeably at its discretion; return flights from Nairobi may be routed via Masai Mara at the company's discretion.
scheduleFootnotes.b: All Masai Mara and Governors' Mugie flights operate with a minimum of 2 passengers year-round. Other Laikipia flights (Loisaba, Lewa, Ol Pejeta/Komok) require minimum 2 pax in High season, minimum 4 pax in Mid and Low season.
scheduleFootnotes.c: Flight may not route directly as ticketed; may stop via other scheduled destinations.
scheduleFootnotes.d: Flight may be routed via Nairobi, particularly in Mid and Low season.
scheduleFootnotes.e: Passengers may be re-booked onto an equivalent airline/service if load factors or other circumstances require it.
scheduleFootnotes.f: Laikipia-Wilson and Masai Mara-Laikipia flights only operate during peak periods: 01 Jun - 31 Oct and 15 Dec - 31 Mar.

childPolicyNote: Child rate applies ages 2-15 (distinct wording from AirKenya's 'under 12' and from the Soroi portfolio's 5-11/12-17 brackets - do not conflate these three different child-age conventions across carriers/properties.)
insuranceCondition: Wilderness/Governors' Collection requires guests carry travel insurance; uninsured guests are personally liable for medical emergency/evacuation costs and other claims (e.g. lost luggage).
fuelSurcharge: Variable fuel surcharge may be levied if crude oil prices rise significantly; will be communicated in advance. No current surcharge amount stated.
termsReference: Full flight T&Cs at https://www.governorsaviation.com/Terms-and-Conditions/termsandconditions - not reproduced here, refer guests/agents to that link for edge cases.
